summary: Per-character state machine of loading a party preset: a step byte advanced by esv::party_preset::System::ProcessDirtyLoadStates (bg3.exe+0x2DBEC00, switch on the byte: 1 = ..., 2 = DebugSetTotalXPRequest, 6 = spells ...) followed by one esv::PartyPresetCharacter (0x330 bytes). Created by bg3.exe+0x2DC18E0 from bg3.exe+0x2DBC980; read by System::TeleportEntity / SystemLoad.

fields.name: OriginatorPrototype
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2DBEC00 case 6 compares elements (stride 0x30) by int +0, byte +8, 8-byte +0x10/+0x18/+0x20/+0x28: the shape of Script Extender's SpellMetaId (ExposedTypes.h), which this struct equals.

fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: Constructor bg3.exe+0x2AE6D40 writes the null handle 0xFFC0000000000000.

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: Constructor memsets 0x1C0 bytes at +8 and runs FUN_1422D54B0 on them (an embedded object, not decoded).

fields.name: field_1B4
fields.evidence: Inside the +8 object; read as component+0x1BC by bg3.exe+0x2DBEC00 case 2 as the level whose XP becomes DebugSetTotalXPRequest.TotalXP.

fields.name: field_1C8
fields.evidence: Constructor: memset 0xE0 then eh_vector_constructor_iterator(+0x1C8, 0x10, 14, FUN_1405917F0, FUN_140591800): 14 objects of 16 bytes with constructor/destructor.

fields.name: field_2A8
fields.evidence: Array header (pointer) zeroed by the constructor (+0x2A8 ptr, +0x2B0 capacity, +0x2B4 size); element type not read.

fields.name: Spells
fields.evidence: Constructor zeroes an Array header here; bg3.exe+0x2DBEC00 case 6 walks component+0x2F0 (= +0x2E8 here) with stride 0x30 and size at component+0x2FC, appending the missing ones (FUN_1407A4DE0) to another array.

fields.name: field_308
fields.evidence: Constructor writes 0xFFFFFFFF; bg3.exe+0x2DBC980 reads +0x308 of a preset character record (pointer + 0x61 * 8) and copies it with IncRef into LoadSession.field_80.

fields.name: field_30C
fields.evidence: Constructor zeroes it (8-byte store +0x30C); read as component+0x314 by bg3.exe+0x2DBEC00 case 2 as the upper bound of the XP value.

fields.name: field_31C
fields.evidence: Constructor writes 0x3F800000 (1.0f) as the low half of an 8-byte store at +0x31C

fields.name: Step
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2DC18E0 writes byte 0; bg3.exe+0x2DBEC00 (via getter bg3.exe+0x2DC1BB0) increments it and switches on it (cases 1..7) to run the preset loading steps.

fields.name: Character
fields.evidence: Creator calls constructor FUN_142AE6D40(comp + 8), which fills 0x330 bytes; bg3.exe+0x2DBC980 destroys an array of the same objects with stride 0x330 through esv::PartyPresetCharacter::~PartyPresetCharacter, so the object is an esv::PartyPresetCharacter. 8 + 0x330 = 0x338 = registry size.

open_questions: The 0x1C0-byte object at Character+8 (FUN_1422D54B0) and the 14 16-byte objects at Character+0x1C8 are not decoded.
Element types of the four arrays at Character+0x2A8..+0x2D8.
Meaning of the floats/ints at Character+0x30C..+0x32C (a position/rotation? only defaults known).
The component destructor slot (LAB_1422B6E10) is not a function start in the decomp base and was not read.
